name: harvard-ea
description: Claude Code plugins for the HUIT Spark Innovation Platform (inno-platform.spark.huit.harvard.edu).

plugins.name: innovation-platform
plugins.description: Build and ship apps on the HUIT Spark Innovation Platform: create an app via the inno-platform MCP server as a container (any stack, the default type), a function (its own Cloudflare Worker), or an MCP server for AI assistants (mcp-function / mcp-container) behind the platform's own front door, write it against the platform's application + app-security contracts, run the security gates before shipping through CI/CD, and manage access to a live app.
